```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Run every chunk from the project folder (two levels up from R/mac_linux/), where data/ is
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "../..")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3.9)
```

**Data:** `data/stats_example.csv`, 2 groups (control, P80), 6 wells each. Simulated; one
experiment, so n = wells.

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 15) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()))
```

```{r import}
d <- read_csv("data/stats_example.csv") %>%
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, "ctrl", "P80"))
```

## 1. Describe

```{r describe}
d %>% group_by(group) %>% get_summary_stats(value, type = "mean_sd")
```

## 2. Check the assumptions

Normality per group (Shapiro–Wilk) and equal variances (Levene).

```{r assumptions}
d %>% group_by(group) %>% shapiro_test(value)
d %>% levene_test(value ~ group)
```

## 3a. Parametric: Student and Welch t-test

Student assumes equal SDs; Welch does not and is the default. `detailed = TRUE` adds the difference
and its 95 % CI.

```{r t-tests}
d %>% t_test(value ~ group, var.equal = TRUE)
d %>% t_test(value ~ group, detailed = TRUE)
d %>% cohens_d(value ~ group)
```

## 3b. Nonparametric: Mann–Whitney U (Wilcoxon rank-sum)

```{r wilcoxon}
d %>% wilcox_test(value ~ group)
d %>% wilcox_effsize(value ~ group)
```

## 3c. Skewed data: log-transform, then parametric again

```{r log}
d_log <- d %>% mutate(log_value = log10(value))
d_log %>% group_by(group) %>% shapiro_test(log_value)
d_log %>% t_test(log_value ~ group, detailed = TRUE)
```

## 4. Plot: every point + mean ± SD

```{r plot}
p <- ggplot(d, aes(group, value)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 3, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#333333") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1),
               geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, colour = "#0028A5", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4, colour = "#0028A5") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative level", caption = "Simulated data, mean ± SD, n = 6 wells")
p
ggsave("figures/01_statistics.png", p, width = 5, height = 3.9, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
```
